name: opentomato
description: OpenTomato — macOS 桌面小说写作工具：pi agent 内核 + 可视 diff 审批 + 多角色子 agent

scripts.dev: bun run --filter @opentomato/core build && concurrently -k -n core,desktop "bun run --filter @opentomato/core watch" "bun run --filter @opentomato/desktop dev"
scripts.build: bun run --filter @opentomato/core build && bun run --filter @opentomato/desktop build
scripts.dist: bun run build && bun run --filter @opentomato/desktop dist
